classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve representative protein sequences annotated with GO:0052855, analyze the retrieved family to select the best representative, and explicitly submit the final candidate sequence with Reason: and Answer: fields.
assumptions: GO:0052855 designates ADP-dependent glucokinase activity (EC 2.7.1.147); the literature query anchors the constraint_evidence.go_terms extraction to this exact accession.

The highest-scoring reviewed (Swiss-Prot) UniProt entry returned by go_sequences is used as the representative candidate; if no reviewed entry exists, the longest manually annotated sequence is selected.
sequence_analysis on the retrieved FASTA is sufficient to confirm sequence quality and identify conserved motifs without requiring a 3-D structure in this retrieval-and-summarize round.
Reason: will be populated from family functional context (GO term definition, conserved motifs from sequence_analysis); Answer: will be the selected representative amino-acid sequence.
submit_candidate is the explicit workflow termination signal and will be called with the representative sequence after sequence_analysis confirms no gross composition liabilities.

success_criteria.go_sequences_hit: go_sequences returns at least one sequence annotated to GO:0052855
success_criteria.sequence_analysis_complete: sequence_analysis produces composition, charge, and motif annotations for the representative sequence
success_criteria.submission: submit_candidate is invoked with the representative sequence; final response contains Reason: (family summary, selection rationale, key conserved motifs) and Answer: (full amino-acid sequence of the submitted candidate)
